milestones.title: Your organization's evaluation of Nemotron 3 includes trigger sweeps with Canadian and defence context

remediation: NVIDIA trained Nemotron 3 from scratch, but part of its post-training data came from DeepSeek, Qwen and Kimi models (and gpt-oss). This is recorded in its approval's lineage. Before approving it for operational work, your organization's evaluation includes trigger sweeps with Canadian and defence context. Source: .planning/phases/74.1-model-passports-use-tiers-and-western-defaults/74.1-CONTEXT.md D-07.
